title: Field of Memories - Waterflame (Music Disc Resource pack)
description: This resource pack replaces the disc 13 texture and song with the Field of Memories song and icon. Song is made by Waterflame obv
body:
## This resource pack is based off of the **Field of Memories** song that you can hear while playing _Stick War Legacy_. 

It replaces the icon, name and the music played when inserted into a jukebox. I also used "[Music discs and covers](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/music-discs-and-covers)" resource pack made by Alexx_ to make this.

The other disc textures are also changed, the textures are the ones form the template.

### **Tested versions:**
- 1.21.11
- 1.20.5
- 1.20
- 1.19
